newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash grades and outright price perk up late.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash grades and outright price perk up late.

text.p: U.S. cash grades and the outright price for West Texas Intermediate/Cushing perked up in late trading on Thursday amid pent-up refinery buying, traders said.
May WTI/Cushing traded at 19.50 a barrel in the aftermarket, up eight cents from the NYMEX settlement, traders said. The benchmark was trading around $19.40-50 late in the day.
Traders were contemplating talk that ARCO would deliver Nigerian Bonny Light crude into NYMEX upon expiry of the May contract next Tuesday.
As owner of the oil installations at Cushing, ARCO is seen as being in a sound position to make such a delivery.
"(ARCO) has the cheapest incremental cost," one Gulf Coast refiner said.

Exchange for Physcials (EFPs) have been fetching a premium of around six to eight cents, and got as high as 12 cents late last week, as traders attempt to shift out of paper positions to avoid the uncertainty of receiving a crude other than West Texas Intermediate/Cushing upon expiry.
A Bonny Light delivery into NYMEX would require the buyer to pay a premium of 60 cents a barrel.

Foreign barrels are rarely delivered into NYMEX. ARCO was again the focus of attention several months ago when an Oseberg delivery appeared imminent. That cargo was eventually sold, averting the exchange.
Among the grades, West Texas Sour/Midland was talked around WTI/Cushing minus $1.90-85, up 10 cents from late Wednesday. The grade was dealt at minus $1.90, traders said.
Eugene Island was tighter at minus $1.75-65 a barrel, up 20 cents.
Thinly traded Bonito Sour was dealt earlier at minus $1.20 a barrel.
Sweet grades were similarly robust. Light Louisiana Sweet/St. James moved higher to minus 26-25 cents, up a full 10-14 cents from Wednesday.
The upturn was attributed to the narrowing WTI/Brent spread, which could discourage transatlantic trade.
WTI/Midland was slightly stronger at minus 30-29 cents.
Heavy Louisiana Sweet/Empire gained a steep 25 cents to talk around 75-70 under WTI/Cushing. The grade switched hands at minus 80 and 85 cents.
